b: NOAA Fisheries is hosting two National Angler Listening Sessions to give the fishing community a space to learn about the Recreational Angler Partnership Improvement Directive (RAPID) initiative, ask questions, and provide feedback on current recreational fisheries data collection systems. RAPID National Steering Committee members will be available to answer questions and relay comments to RAPID regional planning teams.
Thursday, December 3, 2026, from 5 p.m. to 7 p.m. ET
Wednesday, December 9, 2026, from 8 p.m. to 10 p.m. ET

RAPID is the collaborative initiative to remodel recreational fisheries data collection and was launched in response to stakeholder feedback calling for regional flexibility and more reliable catch estimates to inform stock assessments and fisheries management.
The more participation there is throughout this process, the more closely the resulting framework will match the unique fisheries data needs in each region.
Contact Tim Sartwell (tim.sartwell@noaa.gov) or Anna Mehlhorn (anna.mehlhorn@noaa.gov), or visit the RAPID webpage.
